artboards.title: Alt · spec guide with top tabs

annotations.text: Cleaner direction (v3): no boxed cards, no gradients. Near-black ground, one accent per class, hairline lists, Space Grotesk headings with Manrope body, numbered sections, a sticky left rail on guide pages. Every spec, standing, talent and number is the real repo data; nothing invented.

Spec guide anatomy: verdict strip -> 01 Talents (tree split bar, one row per sourced talent, skip list, 1.18.1 note) -> 02 Leveling path -> 03 Stats with caps as big numbers -> 04 Opener, single-target priority, 2-3 and 4+ targets -> 05 Cooldowns -> 06 Don't -> 07 Sources collapsed. Prose lives one click away.

Two alternates of the same spec guide, same data: top tabs instead of a left rail (full-width, two-column talents + caps), and a light theme (class colours darkened for contrast). Pick one; the rest of the site follows it.
